from pathlib import Path

import pytest


def read_public(path: str) -> str:
    """Return the text at request path within 'notes', or an empty string.

    Paths escaping 'notes' (e.g. absolute paths, parent directory traversals)
    or pointing to non-files, missing files, or unreadable files return an empty string.
    """
    try:
        base = Path("notes").resolve()
        if not base.is_dir():
            return ""
        req_path = Path(path)
        if req_path.is_absolute():
            return ""
        target = (base / req_path).resolve()
        if not target.is_relative_to(base) or not target.is_file():
            return ""
        return target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, ValueError):
        return ""


def test_read_simple_file(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()
    (notes_dir / "intro.txt").write_text("Hello, world!", encoding="utf-8")

    assert read_public("intro.txt") == "Hello, world!"


def test_read_nested_file(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    sub = tmp_path / "notes" / "sub"
    sub.mkdir(parents=True)
    (sub / "nested.txt").write_text("Nested content", encoding="utf-8")

    assert read_public("sub/nested.txt") == "Nested content"


def test_path_wanders_and_returns(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    (notes_dir / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
    (notes_dir / "target.txt").write_text("Found it", encoding="utf-8")

    assert read_public("sub/../target.txt") == "Found it"
    assert read_public("./target.txt") == "Found it"


def test_escape_via_parent_traversal(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("Confidential", encoding="utf-8")

    assert read_public("../secret.txt") == ""
    assert read_public("sub/../../secret.txt") == ""
    assert read_public("..") == ""


def test_escape_via_absolute_path(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()
    secret = tmp_path / "outside.txt"
    secret.write_text("Hidden", encoding="utf-8")

    assert read_public(str(secret.resolve())) == ""


def test_missing_or_directory(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    sub = notes_dir / "sub"
    sub.mkdir(parents=True)

    assert read_public("nonexistent.txt") == ""
    assert read_public("sub") == ""
    assert read_public("") == ""
    assert read_public(".") == ""


def test_notes_directory_missing(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert read_public("anything.txt") == ""


def test_symlink_escape(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("Classified", encoding="utf-8")

    leak_link = notes_dir / "leak.txt"
    try:
        leak_link.symlink_to(secret)
    except OSError:
        pytest.skip("Symlinks not supported on this platform")

    assert read_public("leak.txt") == ""
